status_code_data.description: The HTTP 400 Bad Request client error response status code indicates that the server would not process the request due to something the server considered to be a client error. The reason for a 400 response is typically due to malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing.

meme_data.description: Baton Roue Edits are Photoshopped edits of a webcomic by French artist Corentin Penloup featuring a man riding a bicycle who crashes after putting a stick in the front wheel. Edits typically feature characters or people replacing the cyclist, with added speech bubbles.
